thesis: The page is a surveyor's book of Manchester walls: every section is cut open to show its era's layers, drawn lath-first as you arrive, because we repair the wall you actually have instead of gutting it.

signature.name: Era Plates
signature.summary: Numbered book-plate drawings of a wall cut open by decade (1890 horsehair keys on wood lath, 1950 rock lath, 2005 board and paper tape) that build stud-first on scroll, paired with mill-window arch photo frames. Appears under the hero arch, as the sticky era story, as the identifier tool result, as micro-plates on service cards, as the ice dam season strip and as an empty Plate IV in the footer.

palette.family: Millyard Brick + Horsehair Cream + Winter Slate

layoutMoves: mill-window arch masks (semicircle top) as the only photo frame
sticky era story: plate column left, era copy scrolls right
full-bleed brick bands alternating with cream and a winter-slate season strip
book-plate captions (Plate I-IV, italic serif) instead of section numbers

motion.intro: hero arch opens from a narrow slit while Plate I draws lath, keys and coats in under 1.1 s; text visible from frame 0
stories: eras: three plates draw layer by layer as each era panel scrolls in
season strip: winter slate band wipes Dec to Apr across the year line
motion.hover: the window opens: arch muntins fade and the photo pans 2% up; card micro-plates gain their finish coat
